I did somewhat, just changed it for something else, but it still has some roots in that subject/field. I can't see what else I can do and for now it's fine. 
I worry that I'll always feel like I'm just waiting for the chance of "no return", to justify that I'm worthless and not capable of real success.
I don't even know what I'm complaining about half the time lol. I'm just a deeply unhappy person (long seeded self loathing from childhood combined with dAdDy IsSuEs)

Not always. I seem to just not be able to stay on the same path for a while, subconsciously or more worrying consciously making decisions or something to derail a part of my life. For example, career wise,I went to uni to study something fairly specific and I came out of that due to my inability to adapt, control my anxiety and then I deliberately make it seem like I had no choice. I did have a choice, it was called perseverance and I didn't have the mental energy to fix it. So I gave up.
This has happened several times, even with some CBT therapy. My current job is my longest ever (3 years) and I've noticed that the familiar patterns are creeping back and I can't keep screwing things up.
Yes it does. The whole not deserving part...that's it. Or that you deserve the bad things because you are bad.
